rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for telling a story or account again, often in a different way.

example.english: After you hear the story, retell it to me once.
example.traditional: 你聽完個故事，再重講一次畀我聽。
example.jyutping: nei5 teng1 jyun4 go3 gu3 si6 zoi3 cung4 gong2 jat1 ci3 bei2 ngo5 teng1

rows.note: Use this when relaying what you read or heard in your own words rather than simply repeating it.

example.english: They retell the content of the newspaper to us in their own words.
example.traditional: 佢將報紙上面嘅內容轉述畀我哋聽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoeng1 bou3 zi2 soeng6 min6 ge3 noi6 jung4 zyun2 seot6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 teng1

rows.note: Use this as the formal or written equivalent of telling something again or paraphrasing it.

example.english: You need to retell the research findings in the report.
example.traditional: 你要喺報告入面重述研究結果。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 hai2 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 cung4 seot6 jin4 gau3 git3 gwo2
